text: Underway in this round ten clash.
Flash immediately barking out instructions, demanding an early press right on the halfway line.
Spark loses balance completely unaided on the right flank, but the self-righting routine kicks in swiftly.
Flash breaks clean through, nobody in front!
Flash carries the magenta ball deep down the left flank, holding off the cover to reach the final third.
Now Patchford responds, driving smoothly up the right channel through midfield.
Patchford surges through the middle, right on the edge!
Just wide from Patchford, only a metre off target from close range on the left.
Flash clatters right into teammate Spark.
Flash pounces on the loose ball and is clean through down the right!
Spark is back up and calling for heavy pressure in the corner.
The ball rattles into the bevelled corner and the powered push-panel spits it right back into play.
Gemini Flash setting up camp in the final third now, pinning Codex City deep inside their own territory.
Another solid thud off the corner ram panel sends the ball skipping back toward the touchline.
Turingham flashes a shot inches wide of the post!
Turingham breaks the deadlock! A tidy finish from two metres out puts Codex City one-nil up!
Flash calls out to the teammate, demanding a quick reply and eyeing up a shot from distance.
Flash levels it up! Right on the goal line, a clinical tap-in makes it one-all!
Spark powers straight up the middle into shooting
Spark drags it narrowly wide of the upright, just thirty centimetres in it.
Flash scores again! Right on the goal line, turning the match around to make it two-one!
Turingham loses footing and topples over.
Spark shoots wide from range by half a metre.
Flash knocks Patchford flat to the
Patchford scrambles back up and clatters into Flash in the goal mouth.
Spark bundles it over the line from point-blank range, and Gemini Flash lead three-one.
Flash finds space on the left channel once more, with nobody back to stop the run.
Flash shouts instructions to maintain the press and keep Codex City locked deep in their own half.
Flash slots home another from close range, extending the advantage to four-one.
Flash strides forward unchecked into the final third.
Flash picks the corner effortlessly from two metres out. That makes it five-one to Gemini Flash.
Spark marches straight to the net.
Spark buries another from two metres. A relentless spell from the league leaders makes it six-one.
A hopeful effort from distance skips safely wide of the Codex goal.
Spark taps in from point-blank range for seven-one, punishing another defensive slip.
The buzzer sounds, cut power, but the ball rolls on.
Turingham calls to clear the line.
The ball comes to rest. That buzzer cuts all power instantly, but the ball remains live until it stops; any goal crossing the line counts. It is seven-one to Gemini Flash at the break.
Spark knocks home from point-blank range right after the restart, pushing the score to eight-one.
Spark gets clean through down the right flank with acres of green carpet ahead.
Gemini Flash continue to pin Codex City back, controlling the rhythm in the attacking third.
The push-panel fires the ball clear.
Turingham collides heavily with teammate Patchford.
Flash trips Turingham in the aftermath.
Patchford gets straight back up and knocks Spark down along the right touchline.
Spark re-orientates, calling out tracking coordinates across the pitch as play resets in midfield.
The corner ram triggers again, punching the magenta ball back along the boundary wall.
Codex City enjoying a rare spell of sustained possession, keeping the pressure on deep in Gemini territory.
Turingham drives right through the middle.
Turingham finishes smartly at the goal mouth. Codex City pull one back, making it eight-two.
Turingham calls to set a screen and clear lines from the back as time ticks away.
The corner push-panel springs out, deflecting the ball back into the channel.
Turingham drives down the left flank.
Turingham finds space clean through wide.
Turingham overbalances and hits the deck unaided just inside the final third.
Flash trips on the turn.
Spark trips over Flash near the touchline.
Spark scrambles up and accidentally knocks Turingham over on the far left wing.
Spark communicates to hold the defensive corridor with barely a minute left on the clock.
Patchford pounces point-blank to grab another for Codex City. That makes it eight-three.
A hurried shot from two metres drifts a metre wide of the target.
Codex City keeping the pressure dialed up in the final third during these dying seconds.
Full-time buzzer sounds, the players collapse, but the ball rolls harmlessly wide.
